title: Scalar linearity of a localization lift
statement: Let $k$ be a commutative ring and let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D,\mathcal E$ be $k$-linear categories [def-weil-linear-category]. Let $q:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be an additive $k$-linear localization at a class $W$ [def-weil-pbc-additive-functor, def-weil-linear-functor, lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property]. Let $U:\mathcal C\to\mathcal E$ and $G:\mathcal D\to\mathcal E$ be additive functors equipped with a natural isomorphism $G\circ q\cong U$. Then $U$ is $k$-linear if and only if $G$ is $k$-linear.

mathlib_searches.query: A functor descending through an R linear localization is R linear if its composite with localization is R linear
Given a natural isomorphism L composed with G is isomorphic to F a linear localization functor L reflects scalar linearity of G
A lifted functor through a linear localization is linear

mathlib_match.how: Exact scalar-preservation equivalence at lines 69-93, specialized to commutative k. The natural isomorphism is the Lifting datum. Both U and G are already assumed additive, so this equivalence of scalar preservation is equivalently linearity in def-weil-linear-functor.

from.place: Final integral scalar-extension paragraph of def-weil-rationalization-karoubi: completed derived tensor with O_L, levelwise modulo powers of the two uniformizers; scalar linearity of the lift of the K-flat complex construction.
